hero.sub: Portrait sessions that capture who you are — not how you pose.

manifiesto.label: Manifesto
manifiesto.p1: Most of the people I photograph have never posed before. That's why my work starts long before I pick up the camera — in the conversation, in finding a way for you to let go and simply be yourself.
manifiesto.p2: I work with natural and artificial light to build clean images with intention and character. But technique is the easy part. What matters is what the photo ends up saying about you.

estudio.label: The studio
estudio.p1: I'm Guillermo Álvarez, a portrait photographer based in Mexico City. My technical background taught me to look with precision — today I use that same eye to find the exact gesture that makes a photograph feel real.
estudio.p2: Every session is a collaboration, not a production. I work with natural and artificial light to build images with intention, but the goal is never just to look good — it's to recognize yourself in every image.

trabajo.verGaleria: See the full gallery on Pixieset

servicios.sub: From your first professional portrait to the session that marks a turning point — every project gets the same attention to detail, no matter the size.
servicios.plan1Desc: Individual or as a couple. Studio or natural light. For social media, a professional profile, or just for yourself.
servicios.plan2Desc: Content for your brand, your business, or that digital presence you want to build for real.
servicios.plan2Item3: Full content set for your social media
servicios.plan3Desc: LinkedIn, resume, executive presence. The first impression your professional image makes.
servicios.notePre: Your project doesn't fit any category?
servicios.notePost: and we'll figure it out together — every price is a starting point, not a limit.

proceso.label: The process
proceso.sub: You don't need experience in front of a camera. You need direction. I take care of the rest.
proceso.step1Desc: Via WhatsApp or the form. No commitment, no technical jargon — just tell me what you have in mind.
proceso.step2Desc: A short questionnaire tells me what inspires you, what makes you uncomfortable, and what you want to achieve. I arrive at the session already knowing how to direct you.
proceso.step3Desc: I give you clear direction, pose by pose. You don't need to know what to do with your hands — that's what I'm here for.
proceso.step4Desc: In 3 to 7 days depending on the package, via Pixieset. Edited photos, ready to show off.
proceso.pay1: Deposit when you book your date

colabora.label: Collaborations
colabora.sub: Every now and then I open space for projects at no cost — not as free promotion, but as a selection of collaborations I'm interested in building. Models, makeup artists, stylists, designers, brands, and content creators: if you have an idea, I want to hear it.
colabora.buscoItem1: A clear idea, even a small one
colabora.buscoItem2: Real commitment to the agreed date
colabora.buscoItem3: A desire to create something outside the commercial mold
colabora.obtienesItem1: A complete session at no cost
colabora.obtienesItem3: Credit and tagging in the published work
colabora.mini2: I review and reply within 5–7 days
colabora.mini3: If there's a match, we coordinate everything
colabora.disclaimer: Not every application is accepted — I select a few projects per season so I can give them the attention they deserve.
